reviews.x: I love this stuff! Even if it did nothing for my hair, I'd still use it. I am obsessed with the smell of this stuff. Yeah, yeah. It makes my hair as smooth and soft as freshly spun baby down... But the smell!! OMG! They should make a home scent like this. I'd never leave my house.

reviews.t: I do not like products that leave hair hard
reviews.x: My daughter has curly hair and I have wavy hair.  I do not like products that leave hair hard, crunchy, or flaky.  I used to use Paul mitchell sculpting foam but stopped for a while and decided to try something new.  I got this as a sample in a beauty box and loved it so I bought a full size one here.  It is a very light hold without any stickyness, leaves your hair soft, the smell is not an issue.  It works for both my coarse wavy hair and my daughters curly hair.  If you need something to real

Love this product.  I got a small sample in a GlossyBox subscription and had to buy more.  Keeps the tips of my A-line bob in check.  Strangely beauty supplies and salon are no longer selling Sebastian products, so I had no choice but to order from Amazon.

Love this stuff! It is the first curling product that's not sticky. I don't know that it really helps to curl my hair, so you may be disappointed if you expect that. It is perfect for people who already have wavy or curly hair. I could never let my hair (long, mid-back length, light curl) air dry before because it had no body and would get super frizzy in the Florida humidity. With this, I can brush a bit through my wet hair along with some salt spay and some leave in conditioner spray (for adde

reviews.t: No mess, no smelly smell, & bouncy curls!!!
reviews.x: I've used this product for about a month now and my curls are so great!!! It's all of them nice and curly not just the random mush, works way better than mousse as I've had my fairest shade with those as well. And it's so light on your hair, smells good, and doesn't make your hair nothing but soft!! Love it

reviews.t: The product smells nice but that's about it
reviews.x: The product smells nice but that's about it. It didnt do anything for my hair aside from giving it a great scent. The seller was great and would definitely purchase other products from them.

reviews.t: Love this product for my waves
reviews.x: Love this product for my waves. Doesn't leave my hair crunchy and gives my curls soft flow. Use it daily

I have loose corkscrew curls that decide what they feel like doing day to day. Sometimes they are frizzy, sometimes they curl beautifully, sometimes they just lay there, etc. I've tried a lot of products and some work ok, but I've loved this Sebastian Whipped Cream since the first use and never looked back! It makes my hair nice and shiney and the curls are tightet and not messy. The product feels weightless and I can touch my hair and it feels like I don't have any product in at all. I love thi

I received this product and waited a couple of weeks to use it. On first use the product came out runny. On second use it did not come out at all. It’s now completely useless. Will not purchase from this seller again as it is now just past the return period and I’m stuck with a defective product.

reviews.t: Volume and Shine All in One!
reviews.x: My hair can sometimes be a little lifeless.  Sebastian Whipped Cream Light Conditioning adds volume, makes styling very easy and it holds for a long time.  I highly recommend this product Sebastian Whipped Creme Light Conditioning.  Definitely happy with the results - Well worth the Money!

This is my most favorite hair product of all time! Leaves your hair manageable,with body. I have fine hair, takes the frizz away when it is humid out. It's not like a typical mousse and in fact looks like whipped cream when you put it in your hand. You do not need very much at all.

Love, love this product; best I ever used and smells heavenly!  Only problem is that it sometimes squirts out too fast and then gets wasted.  Also looses it fluffy whip texture when toward bottom but still works well.  Other than that; love, love it!

I have generally frizzy, color-treated hair that is usually looks too greasy with regular conditioner, but dry and straw-like without it. This is a great product that gives me the bounce and smoothness I was looking for in a conditioning mousse.

You REALLY have to use a SMALL AMOUNT! Comes out quickly, very creamy and a tiny but goes a long way... but sadly, volume isn’t all that. I prefer BIG SEXY HAIR. (Red can). Not for me but that’s just me.

reviews.t: Excellent product, quick shipping and smooth transaction
reviews.x: Excellent product, quick shipping and smooth transaction. This product has been a staple in my home for many years, absolutely love how it feels in my hair. So soft, weightless and smells good too.
LOVE this product!!  We live in humid, humid Miami and I have to fight frizzy hair.  This product WORKS!  Would highly recommend, and the price is less expensive than if purchase at a salon.

reviews.t: Great mousse. Found this at salon and ordered it ...
reviews.x: Great mousse.  Found this at salon and ordered it from amazon.  Lightweight, super foamy and it totally moisturizes as if you had conditioner as well.  My new go to hair product!
This. Is. Amazing!!! This is amazing when I wear my hair curly. It provides light conditioning and ZERO frizz. My hair feels sooo moisturized since I added this to my routine.

reviews.t: I apply it to the ends of my hair and ...
reviews.x: I apply it to the ends of my hair and a little throughout to keep my hair from drying out and getting frizzy. Works well, though I wish there were more product for the cost.

reviews.t: This is the best mouse I've ever used
reviews.x: This is the best mouse I've ever used! Its soft and creamy. I have naturally wavy hair and its so nice when I'm in a hurry to scrunch it with a little mouse and go!

reviews.t: Great leave in conditioner for my girl with curly hair
reviews.x: Great leave in conditioner for my girl with curly hair! Doesn't leave hair crunchy, greasy, or with a weighted film. Light & softening...with a great clean smell.
The nozzle stopped working after only a few uses, so even though the container is almost completely full, I can't get the product to come out of the container.

reviews.t: Soft curls, no crunch, and doesn’t weigh curls down, but was hoping for more frizz control.
reviews.x: Like the texture and coverage when applying. Hair is soft, definitely no crunch and curls have a nice shape, but I was hoping for a little more frizz control.
Sebastian whipped cream light  makes my hair feel nice and soft, but doesn't give any real shaping to it. And after a day or so, my hair feels a bit greasy.

reviews.t: Great for my thick curly hair that tends to frizz ...
reviews.x: Great for my thick curly hair that tends to frizz without some kind of product.  This one does the job without making my hair look wet and crunchy.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product's scent, describing it as a major highlight.
Many reviewers say it leaves hair soft, smooth, and not crunchy or sticky.
Several reviewers with wavy or curly hair report improved curls and bounce.
Some reviewers note the product dispenses too quickly or wastes product, and one reports defective packaging.
A few reviewers say it did little for their hair or lacked volume.
